title: Web service depends Wifi connection
symptom: The Web service provides a '_Temporary unavailable or under maintenance_' error page if my Android phone (A5 2017) is not connected to any Wifi network.
cause: The browser behavior made me wrong, cause returns a _webservice unavailable page_ when wifi (and optionally) data is off. On a reload/refresh, browser identifies that phone is offline. Using http request tool, the web service still responds. It seems that Fitbit companion apps requires an internet connection to initiate any connection.
fix: No fix was provided; the user gave up on this way for watch integration.
